title: Disco Phantom Ball
description: A dramatic baroque-style scene featuring a large glittering disco ball suspended in a dark theatrical space. A woman in an ornate gold and orange gown dances dynamically on the left while another figure in flowing blue and orange robes appears on the right, with a formally dressed couple visible in the background.
prompt: A baroque theatrical scene with dramatic lighting featuring a large sparkling disco ball hanging from above. On the left a woman in an elaborate flowing gold and orange gown dances with dynamic movement and fabric billowing around her. On the right another mysterious figure in deep blue and orange robes emerges from heavy curtains. In the background a formally dressed couple stands near the center of the composition. Dark swirling background with theatrical drapery and chains, high contrast lighting, rich textures and dramatic atmosphere.
